## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Restore approval at the configured minimum before merge because the release gate blocks releases that meet the threshold exactly.

## Changes

The pull request regenerates the deployment catalog with production service names and ports, changes the health check to use truthiness, and makes the release gate require more than the configured minimum.

## Critical

- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases at the configured minimum — `approved(2, minimum=2)` returns `False` because the new `>` comparison excludes equality, even though the module specifies “at least the configured number of approvals.” — Releases with exactly the required approvals stay blocked until they receive an extra approval.

## Important

- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Keep deployment catalog entries uniform — Reading `port` from each top-level entry fails at `review_note`, whose value is a string. Every service entry is an object with `port` and `enabled` fields. — A deployment tool that loads ports from every catalog entry cannot finish loading the catalog.
